forbidden: choosing N, window, sector or threshold from these results

heldFixed: 21-session blocks on the common KRX/NYSE schedule
expanding bucket calibration (horizon 126, prior strength 30, min 20 dates, gross)
realistic dated cost schedule (benchmark_alpha.REALISTIC_COSTS, ETF legs without sell tax)
spec.initialState: 100% regional ETF; the ETF-only path never trades
spec.missingData: a block that cannot be valued stops that path (INPUT_UNAVAILABLE) at that block; no name is dropped and no return is filled with zero; unmatured horizons are PENDING, not zero

pairedInference.statistic: per-block log NAV growth difference, annualized
